statements.status_notes: Debian security tracker lists CVE-2013-4441 as unfixed for pwgen 2.08-2 on trixie with urgency unimportant and notes that memorable phoneme-mode passwords are documented by-design behavior (Debian bug #726578). No upstream or Debian security fix is available to track or backport. Phonemes mode is the default output path of the shipped pwgen binary, so not_affected cannot be claimed for dhi/pkg-pwgen.
